$comment: Settings of the economy module (packages/economy, F-14). Provider, endpoints and limits live here, not in code. Field names of the provider API follow its public docs (https://poe.ninja/docs/api) and are verified against real responses only when the app first runs online; until then tests use invented responses.
userAgent: {appName}/{appVersion} (unofficial local desktop app, not affiliated with Grinding Gear Games; contact: lemonfreshx3@hotmail.de)
$commentUniques: Unique prices come from the stash overview. The provider documents primaryValue there as 'Estimated value in the league's primary reference currency'; the book uses the exchange responses' core.primary as that currency. Lines of a variant or a corrupted copy, and names the catalog does not resolve to exactly one unique, stay unmapped.

confidence.$comment: Volume (in primary currency units, as the provider reports volumePrimaryValue) at or above which a quote counts as that confidence. Below `medium` it is low.

$commentUserAgent: The provider asks for a contact in the User-Agent; the project owner chose this address (25.11.2026). {appName} comes from appName, so a rename only changes that field.
$commentConfidence: Provisional: the volume thresholds are not calibrated against real data yet.
$commentUniqueConfidence: Provisional thresholds on the number of listings of a unique item; to be calibrated against real data.
